NHAI to Deploy AI-Based Traffic Management Systems on Delhi-NCR Highways

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) plans to implement AI-based Automatic Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) across 1,205 kilometers of highways in the Delhi-NCR region. This initiative, costing Rs 238 crore, aims to enhance traffic management. The deployment is expected to make travel on these highways more high-tech.
